Ryan Cho: Morning all! Ryan here, joining as data infra. Just moved to SF. Big fan of oolong tea and weekend hikes. Quick Qs: where's the shower/bike storage? Also curious if there's a desk reserved for interns occasionally?

Nico (People Ops): Welcome Ryan!! :tada: Showers are in the locker room on level 1, bike racks in garage level B1, ping security for badge access. Intern desks are flexible — we have a hot-desk area in the east wing. I'll leave a welcome sticker pack & hoodie on your desk.

Lina: welcome! :wave: Tea club meets Tuesdays at 3pm in the lounge. Bring oolong!

Maya: hey Ryan — if you want a hiking buddy, I hit Marin on weekends. Also lunch today at 12:15 in the kitchen if you want to join.

DevBot: Onboarding reminder: please complete "Accounts & Access" step.

Ryan Cho: Thanks everyone — joining lunch. Also: is guest WiFi `Redwood-Guest` still the one?

Nico (People Ops): Yes guest WiFi is `Redwood-Guest` pw `welcome2026!`. See you at 12:15.

Lina: oolong squad!

Ryan Cho: Can't wait, thanks for the warm welcome :)
